description: This file defines a state management store for products in a frontend application, likely using Pinia (Vue.js). It includes mock data for products and categories, and provides state variables, getters, and actions for fetching and manipulating product data.

methods.name: fetchProducts
methods.description: Simulates fetching product data and updates the products and featuredProducts state variables.

methods.name: fetchCategories
methods.description: Simulates fetching category data and updates the categories state variable.

methods.name: fetchProductById
methods.description: Fetches a product by its ID, simulating an API call.

methods.description: Searches products matching a query string, with an optional limit.
